**Trigger:** Continuous - run per page type as each is populated. Hard gate before the v1.0 release.

**Milestone:** M12 - v1.0

**Phase:** Continuous, from first content through release

**Breaking:** Non-breaking

## Why it waits

**Already verified:** contrast on resting states, in both themes, by script, with zero failures. That is the smallest part of the claim.

**Not verified:** screen reader traversal, greyscale legibility, 200% zoom, and contrast across all six interaction states - resting, hover, focus, active, disabled, error. Touch targets are covered by `IMP-003`.

Accessibility verified once at the end finds a hundred issues at the most expensive possible moment, and the usual outcome is that the standard is quietly lowered instead. Verified per page type as each is populated, it finds them in ones.

## Definition of Done - additions

- [ ] Findings go back into `DSY-011` S6 as amendments, so the design system learns from each pass rather than each pass repeating the last one's discoveries.
- [ ] An automated subset runs in CI as a check (`IMP-006`'s pattern). The automated part never replaces the manual passes - it only stops regressions between them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every page type is traversed with a screen reader, and the traversal is comprehensible - not merely technically announced.
- [ ] Every page type is legible in greyscale, confirming no meaning is carried by colour alone.
- [ ] Every page type is usable at 200% zoom with no loss of function and no horizontal scrolling of body content.
- [ ] Contrast passes AA in both themes across all six interaction states.
- [ ] Keyboard traversal reaches every interactive element in a sensible order, with focus always visible, and no trap.
- [ ] Diagrams convey the same information through their text alternatives as they do visually (`F-02`).
- [ ] Results are recorded per page type with a date, so a later regression has something to be a regression from.

## Definition of Done - universal

Inherited by every implementation task. `RDM-011` S1 holds the single copy.

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] The `CI` status check passes on the pull request (`WKF-004`)
- [ ] Merged by pull request from a branch; never committed to `main` directly
- [ ] Human-written commenting matching the codebase (`WKF-007`)
- [ ] Keyboard reachable, visible focus, correct semantics; no new AA regression (`DSY-011`, `WEB-012`)
- [ ] Both themes; above and below the responsive breakpoints (`WEB-011`, `DSY-010`)
- [ ] The JavaScript budget still holds (`WEB-014` S2)
- [ ] No specification left in conflict with the work (`CST-001`)
- [ ] Decisions recorded (`D-####`); architectural ones get an ADR (`WKF-013`)
